title: Phone
lede: The Phone component lets you showcase website screenshots or other content within a realistic phone-style frame.

examples.heading: Light
examples.description: The light variant: the frame takes gray-100 with a gray-alpha-400 outline and the side keys gray-alpha-400. The class strings come from the component's client code (the server HTML renders the dark variant only); the merge drops the plain `outline` token the way the rendered dark frame shows.

examples.heading: Without address
examples.description: No address: the screen renders without the bottom gradient and without the navigation bar (back key, address pill, more key). The class strings come from the component's client code; the server HTML renders the addressed state only.

examples.heading: Without notch
examples.description: notch={false}: the frame renders without the island at the top of the screen. The class strings come from the component's client code; the server HTML renders the notched state only.
